name: @w6w-apps/moco
description: Manage MOCO contacts, companies, projects, time-tracking activities and invoices.

w6w.longDescription:
MOCO is a combined CRM, project time-tracking and invoicing tool built for agencies and consultancies. This app covers the day-to-day records a workflow touches: contacts and the companies (customers, suppliers, organizations) they belong to, projects work is booked against, the tracked time activities that make up a project's hours, and the invoices generated from that work.

A fit for syncing contacts and companies with an external CRM, creating or updating a project when a deal closes elsewhere, logging time entries from an external time source, or moving an invoice through its status lifecycle (created → sent → paid) as a workflow tracks payment.
